attackers_goals: The attacker wants to maintain indirect control over the resource. The attacker intends to allow public access, making it harder to detect future activity. Attackers are constantly monitoring for public assets to steal sensitive information.
description: The GCP data asset was publicly shared.
detector_tags: Cloud Data Asset Public Exposure, Data Detection & Response
investigative_actions: Check if the identity intended to change the state of the data asset to public. Change the access policy for the affected asset. Restrict permissions for the identity if needed.
name: GCP data asset shared public
